metric: Phase 7F production fidelity capture compares live loyaltymaster.com runtime sections, and the blog.loyaltymaster.com templates for the blog components, against local library specimens at desktop and mobile viewports. Targets were repointed on 2026-09-28 from the retired sendpush.loyaltymaster.com; the artifacts under showcase/app/artifacts/phase-7f/ are the frozen sendPUSH-era gate evidence until a human-approved re-run replaces them.
productionCheckoutNote: productionSourcePath values point into local checkouts. As of 2026-09-28 the local Clone Codex checkout sits on branch claude/navbar-wordmark-inset-2026-09-07 (b607521, 2026-09-07) and is behind origin/main (c1ce379, 2026-09-24), which is what loyaltymaster.com serves. Selectors were verified read-only against origin/main with git show; update the checkout before running the gate. Entries whose live source exists only on origin/main keep a frozen sendPUSH productionSourcePath and name the live file in productionSourceRef.

billing-toggle-button.notes: Billing toggle is judged against the live pricing cadence control (PricingPage.tsx:230 #pricing, :249 .wf-pricing-toggle on Clone Codex origin/main c1ce379).

button-email.notes: Medium confidence. The newsletter form (LeadForms.tsx:59, NewsletterPage.tsx:34 #newsletter) is the only input+button email pill left on Clone Codex origin/main c1ce379; its label and placeholder differ from the specimen. Hero and CTA bands now use StartCta, a link button with no input.

comparison-table.notes: Full comparison section (eyebrow, h2, intro, wf-compare-table) is gated; the dynamic id resolves to pricing-compared (LoyaltymasterVsCompetitorsPage.tsx:47 on Clone Codex origin/main c1ce379).

cta-trial-full-form.notes: Low-medium confidence. The only live trial form on Clone Codex origin/main c1ce379 (CampaignApplyPage.tsx:21 #apply, LeadForms.tsx #apply-form). /go/ is a noindex campaign route with its own header and footer; the $1 funnel removed the form from /get-your-own-customized-digital-reward-card/.

cta-with-button-email.notes: Medium confidence. The final dark CTA section shell matches (DesignSystemProductPage.tsx:426-427 wf-final-cta #start on Clone Codex origin/main c1ce379), but its action is the StartCta link button, not the email pill; expect drift until the specimen or the gate decision is updated.

faq-accordion.notes: FAQ rows are judged in their default rendered state; the first item of the first group is open by default.
